title: Windows npx launcher cache resilience (#4445)
intent: Fix committed and pushed; running the verification matrix before the Ready PR
progress_summary: Root cause proven: the exact-package probe success is persisted for 24h (#4283), so a cache whose claude.exe the auto-update renamed minutes later keeps being admitted. Added a filesystem scan that quarantines those roots before the probe, plus a pane detail that names the missing executable. 5 new tests green; clippy clean under CI's stable 1.98.1.
